mission: Implement fix for 10000ms timeout error when entering goals after API authentication

rootCause.primaryIssue: Port configuration mismatch between frontend and backend services
details: Frontend API client configured for port 8085, but OpenAI API server running on port 8086
Vite development proxy routing to wrong port (8085 instead of 8086)
10-second timeout too aggressive for complex goal processing operations
Multiple duplicate services running causing potential conflicts

implementedFix.description: Corrected port configuration and increased timeout for reliable goal processing

changes: Updated Codespaces hostname replacement from port 8085 to 8086
Increased API timeout from 10000ms to 30000ms for complex processing
Updated debug logging to reflect correct backend port (8086)
Updated Vite proxy target from localhost:8085 to localhost:8086
Updated health endpoint proxy to correct port 8086

configurationUpdates: API client now correctly routes to OpenAI server on port 8086
Timeout increased from 10 seconds to 30 seconds for better reliability
Proxy configuration aligned with actual running services

testResults.serverHealth: ✅ OpenAI API server responding correctly on port 8086
testResults.expectedOutcome: Goals should now be submittable without 10000ms timeout error

howToVerify: 1. Access the goal strategy testing interface
2. Configure API credentials (should auto-detect environment key)
3. Enter a goal in the input field
5. Goal should process without timeout error and return SMART goal structure
verification.expectedBehavior: User can successfully enter goals and receive SMART goal translations without encountering 10000ms timeout errors
monitoringPoints: Check frontend console for successful API responses
Verify proxy requests route to port 8086
Confirm 30-second timeout provides sufficient processing time

additionalNotes: Previous swarm analyses from similar operations showed consistent timeout issues due to port mismatches
OpenAI API responses typically complete in ~577ms based on logs, well within new 30s timeout
Environment API key is properly configured and accessible
Solution addresses root cause rather than symptoms for sustainable fix
followUpRecommendations: Monitor goal processing times to optimize timeout further if needed
Consider implementing retry logic for network-related failures
Add connection health monitoring to detect port configuration issues early
